name: The mantra of the perfection of wisdom (gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā)
method_summary: The sūtra gives the mantra and praises it (great mantra, mantra of great knowledge, unsurpassed, equal to the unequalled; allayer of all suffering; true, not false); it gives no instruction on how many times or in what way to recite.

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.
